name: Wenceslaus II of Bohemia
contribution: King of Bohemia, Duke of Cracow, and King of Poland.
legacy: In 1300, this person issued the new royal mining code Ius regale montanorum.
image_credit: Master of the Codex Manesse (Additional Painter I) · Public domain

checks.lead: Wenceslaus II of Bohemia (Czech: Václav II.; Polish: Wacław II Czeski; 27 September 1271 – 21 June 1305) was King of Bohemia (1278–1305), Duke of Cracow (1291–1305), and King of Poland (1296–1305).
